Method of Attack: Information stealing, stealing of user passwords, browser cookies, Discord Tokens and other sensitive data.
Stealing of user passwords from Google Chrome. The stolen information is then uploaded to a file storage website and the download link is sent back to the attacker's server.
Information stealing, specifically targeting sensitive files to steal private information such as discord passwords, credit card information, etc.
Information stealing, believed to be associated with BlackCap Grabber attack
Impersonating legitimate packages (e.g., 'requests') to trick users into downloading and installing them.
Impersonating legitimate 'requests' package with the same files but added malicious code in the setup.py file
Malicious binary files embedded in base64 strings that load and execute upon installation.
